change.title: feat(shell): keep the Side panel tabs when the Rail collapses
change.description: ## Summary - When the Rail collapses, the Side panel now keeps its tab bar (Chats, Explorer, Changes, GitHub). - The collapsed Rail shows its four tab icons only when the Side panel is also hidden. - Before this change, a collapsed Rail removed the tab bar from the Side panel and showed the tabs on the Rail. The tabs moved away from the panel that they control. ## Related Issue No issue. The repository owner requested this change and approved the mockup below before implementation. ## Type of Change - [x] feat: new feature - [ ] fix: bug fix - [ ] docs: documentation only - [ ] style: formatting or non-functional styling changes - [ ] refactor: internal cleanup with no behavior change - [ ] perf: performance improvement - [ ] test: adds or updates tests - [ ] build: build or dependency changes - [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow changes - [ ] chore: maintenance or tooling - [ ] revert: reverts a previous change ## What Changed - `SidePanelColumn` shows the tab bar in both Rail states. The tab panel always uses `aria-labelledby`. - `RailCollapsed` shows the tab track only when the Side panel is not on screen: panel hidden, SSH workspace open, or no local project. - `showsFileColumn` (in `explorer-column-blocks.ts`) is the one rule for "Side panel on screen". The explorer column and the collapsed Rail both use it. - `RailColumnIcons` has no pressed state, because the icons show only when the panel is hidden. After an icon shows the panel, focus moves to the panel tab, because the icon unmounts. - Tests: unit tests for the new visibility rule and the focus move. Journey 1 in `shell-revamp-journeys.spec.ts` now hides the Side panel before it clicks the Rail Explorer icon. - Docs: the tour page and the Changes page describe the new rule. ## How It Was Tested - [x] `bun run ci` (Biome lint + format + imports, strict mode) on the changed files - [x] `bun run typecheck` (web and test projects) - [x] `bun run test` (shell and layout suites) - [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (in src-tauri) - [ ] `cargo test` (in src-tauri) - [x] Manual verification completed - [ ] Not applicable Manual verification: a Playwright run against `termul-server` with the built web client, at 1440x900 in dark mode. The run collapses the Rail, hides the Side panel, and clicks **Changes** on the Rail. Each step has assertions on the tab bar, the Rail track, and the selected tab. Local note: `WorkspaceLayout.mobile-breakpoint.test.tsx` fails 3 tests on the base commit as well. This PR does not change that file or its code path. ## Screenshots or Recordings **Approved mockup (before implementation)** ![Mockup: today vs proposed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnoviawan/termul/pr-assets/chat-4f025eb7/mockup.png) **Rail collapsed, Side panel open: the tabs stay in the Side panel** ![Rail collapsed, Side panel open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnoviawan/termul/pr-assets/chat-4f025eb7/rail-collapsed-panel-open.png) **Rail collapsed and Side panel hidden: the Rail shows the four tabs** ![Everything collapsed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnoviawan/termul/pr-assets/chat-4f025eb7/everything-collapsed.png) **Click Changes on the Rail: the Side panel opens on Changes, and the tabs move back into it** ![Rail Changes opens the panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnoviawan/termul/pr-assets/chat-4f025eb7/rail-changes-opens-panel.png) **Rail expanded: no change** ![Rail expanded](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnoviawan/termul/pr-assets/chat-4f025eb7/rail-expanded.png) ## CI & Review Gate - [ ] All CI checks pass (PR Validation, Rust Checks, Build Verification, Security Scans) - [ ] Code review comments from CodeRabbit / Claude have been addressed or resolved - [ ] No unresolved review findings remain ## Checklist - [x] My PR title follows the conventional commit format used by this repo - [x] I linked the related issue or explained why none exists - [x] I updated docs when needed - [x] I added or updated tests when needed - [x] I verified the change does not introduce unrelated modifications - [x] I read AGENTS.md and followed the contributor guidelines - [x] A human reviewed the complete diff before submission (the owner approved the mockup and asked for the merge) --- ## Summary by cubic Keeps the Side panel's tab bar (Chats, Explorer, Changes, GitHub) visible when the Rail is collapsed. The collapsed Rail now shows its tab icons only when the Side panel is off screen (hidden, SSH workspace, or no local project), and clicking a Rail tab icon opens the panel and moves focus to the corresponding tab. **Behavior changes** - The Side panel tab bar stays in the panel in both Rail states. - The collapsed Rail shows its tab icons only while the Side panel is not on screen, with no pressed state since the panel's own tab bar handles selection. - A shared rule (`showsFileColumn`) decides whether the Side panel is on screen, used by both the explorer column and the collapsed Rail. **Tests and docs** - Unit tests cover the visibility rule, focus movement, and the disabled no-project tab icons; the e2e journey hides the Side panel before clicking a Rail tab icon and asserts focus moves to the panel's tab. - Tour and Changes docs describe the new rule and its off-screen cases. Written for commit b0b346cdb51ecc23e389995d556d769d8d8f2f02. Summary will update on new commits. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * The collapsed project rail now shows side-panel tab icons only when the side panel is hidden. Selecting an icon opens the side panel on that tab. * Side-panel tabs remain available in both rail states. * **Documentation** * Updated the getting-started tour and Changes guide to reflect the updated rail behavior.

commits.message:
feat(shell): keep the Side panel tabs when the Rail collapses

The Side panel now shows its Chats, Explorer, Changes and GitHub tab bar in
both Rail states. The collapsed Rail shows its own four tab icons only while
the Side panel is off screen (hidden, SSH workspace, or no local project).
A Rail tab icon shows the panel and moves focus to the panel's tab.

One rule (showsFileColumn) decides whether the Side panel is on screen, for
both the explorer column and the collapsed Rail.

test(shell): cover the no-project Rail tabs and the focus move; document every off-screen case

- cubic: "Document the Side panel as off screen and include those cases."
- cubic: "Add a case rendering ShellRail without an active project and assert that the four tab icons remain present and disabled."
- CodeRabbit: "Assert focus on the Explorer tab after the Rail icon click."
